entries.title: Syphon Filter: Dark Mirror

emulation.notes: Official PS4/PS5 route first; PPSSPP can upscale the PSP original.

entries.title: Syphon Filter: Combat Ops
entries.definitive_edition: PSP PlayStation Network release if preserved

emulation.notes: Use original PSP hardware or PSP emulation only where the PSN package is preserved.

primary.why: Combat Ops is a PSP PlayStation Network multiplayer offshoot tied to Logan's Shadow, with mission editing and sharing; no other platform route is known.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PSP hardware if the PSN release is already preserved; treat online sharing as preservation-sensitive and use ad hoc/local routes where available.

all_releases.fidelity: PSP PlayStation Network multiplayer release with mission editing and online/ad hoc sharing design.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Combat Ops is tied to PSP-era network features, so preservation depends on an existing installation/package and local/ad hoc viability.
